title: Affine-base flat quasi-finite polynomial chart core
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sbc-cohen-macaulay-flat-quasi-finite-chart, there exist n, an open O containing y, an affine open V of T, and a flat locally quasi-finite locally finitely presented map e: O → AffineSpace_n(V) whose projection followed by V's inclusion equals O.ι followed by f.

source.place: Tag 00RH, affine localization, polynomial factorization and flat shrinking (Tags 00QE, 00RE, 00R7, 00RC).

proof.text: Choose an affine open V containing f(y) inside U. Transfer flatness and finite presentation from f restricted to U to f restricted to V using the iterated-restriction arrow isomorphism. Choose an affine source open A containing the lifted point. Open-immersion fibre maps identify the relevant stalks; explicit ring equivalences preserve depth (by transporting regular sequences) and Krull dimension. Thus k=A.ι followed by f restricted to V has the same depth equality at the lifted point. These restriction and stalk comparisons are proved as private Lean helpers in this module.

Apply exists_quasiFinite_polynomial_chart to k. It supplies an affine open B containing the point, n, and a locally finitely presented locally quasi-finite chart e whose projection equals B.ι followed by k, with fibre dimension n.

Apply polynomial_chart_flat_stalk_iff_fibre_depth_and_dimension in the reverse direction at the lifted point of B, using the transported depth equality and the supplied dimension equality. This proves stalk flatness of the selected chart at that point.

Prove openness of the stalk-flat locus W of e. For spectra identify stalk maps with local ring homomorphisms; flatness over the base localization is equivalent to flatness over the base ring. Identify ring localizations with localized self-modules and apply openness of flatness. Transport through canonical affine scheme isomorphisms. On W every stalk map of W.ι followed by e is flat because the open-immersion stalk map is an isomorphism, so the scheme morphism is flat.

Let i=B.ι followed by A.ι followed by the source restriction inclusion, and set O=i(W). Use the canonical isoImage isomorphism to transport W.ι followed by e to a map on O. Composition with open immersions and isomorphisms preserves flatness, local quasi-finiteness and local finite presentation. The selected point belongs to O. The chart projection equation, morphismRestrict_ι and isoImage_inv_ι give exactly the required compatibility with f.

proof_origin.note: Tag 00RH argument made into Lean from existing scheme-level chart and fibre-flatness declarations, with explicit affine restriction, fibre-stalk transport, flat-locus shrinking and image-open gluing. No new holes.

theorem exists_affine_base_flat_quasiFinite_chart_core
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)]
    (y : X) (ht : f y ∈ U)
    (hdepth :
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (O : X.Opens) (V : T.Opens)
      (_ : IsAffine V.toScheme)
      (e : O.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) V.toScheme),
      y ∈ O ∧ Flat e ∧ LocallyQuasiFinite e ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation e ∧
        e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) V.toScheme ↘ V.toScheme) ≫ V.ι =
          O.ι ≫ f
